$comment: Six units. packages/fact-kit-js (component fact-kit-js) and facts (component fact-kit-facts) publish to npm; packages/fact-kit-py (PyPI), packages/fact-kit-rs (crates.io), packages/fact-kit-go (Go module) and packages/fact-kit-swift (Swift package) are the readers in other languages. Go and Swift are each a complete package in its own directory, so a later step can mirror them into their own repositories. A unit's component is its directory name, and its tag is <component>/vX.Y.Z for every unit. Units are the keys of packages. A new unit needs an entry here, an entry in .release-please-manifest.json (0.0.0 until it first releases, so initial-version applies), an entry in release-policy.json and, when it publishes, a case in scripts/lib/release-stages.sh (unit_registry) and scripts/release/publish-units.sh; README.md lists the steps. A release/vX.Y branch carries the whole repository, cut-release.sh --units picks the units that board it, and scoped to the train this config holds only those. separate-pull-requests is false so the train gets a single Release PR with one changelog per unit; each unit keeps its own version and tag. Nothing is released from main.
